assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: premium strategy game HUMAN MOON BASE town panorama, wide landscape 1792x1024. A believable beautiful cohesive human colony built ON A FLAT LEVEL LUNAR PLAIN in vacuum. Camera elevated about 22 degrees, looking across a very broad flat horizontal ground plane, horizon at upper 28 percent. Clean cinematic realistic painted game art, grounded architectural scale, restrained weathered ivory ceramic, graphite structural ribs, muted blue identifiers, small amber and cyan working lights. The colony is a carefully composed asymmetric small town: a substantial low central command building with armored sealed panoramic windows; left a cluster of low cylindrical habitation buildings and a sealed science dome; right two substantial long fully enclosed barrel-vault spacecraft hangars with closed pressure doors; a compact reactor and radiators at rear; small solar array field near far left. Buildings stand naturally on shallow ground footings. Short thick SEALED pressurized walkways connect nearby districts following the terrain; no radial spider arrangement, no floating buildings, no orbital-station modules pasted over each other, no long empty skeletal beams. Each building is distinct and readable, all share perspective and sunlight from upper left. Ground is extremely flat and broadly buildable, fine grey lunar regolith with only small scattered stones and subtle wheel tracks; NO craters, gullies, hills or boulders under or among buildings. Only low distant ridges at the horizon. Black airless sky, almost no stars, no planet in sky so this environment can later be changed between Earth's Moon and Tethys. No clouds, no atmospheric haze, no vegetation, no exposed outdoor living spaces. Leave generous flat foreground and margins around all buildings. No text, no UI, no borders, no labels. Strong unified composition, functional engineering, comfortably grounded, beautiful massing rather than a collection of disconnected icons.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the reference moon base panorama into a clean transparent foreground game layer. Preserve the architectural design, natural camera perspective and lighting of ALL the human base buildings: central command center, left residences and science dome, right sealed hangars, rear power station, solar arrays, sealed linking tunnels. Remove ALL terrain, mountains and sky to genuine transparency. Preserve only buildings, their shallow footings and small neutral translucent contact shadows; no grey ground island, no cutout platform. Zoom the entire architectural composition out slightly so nothing is cut off: 8 percent margin left and right; centered colony occupying middle 80 percent width and roughly middle 55 percent height of wide 1792x1024 canvas. All buildings rest on ONE perfectly level horizontal ground plane; retain source three-dimensional grounding and perspective, not floating station parts. No text. Exterior doors closed, airlocks sealed. Keep all perspective and illumination consistent.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is the desired ground camera and lighting. Produce ONLY the EMPTY landscape for a human lunar base game background. Remove every building, solar panel, machine, vehicle, foundation and construction track from the reference; fill their places with flat level grey lunar regolith. Same wide 1792x1024 composition and perspective, horizon at 14 percent from top. Entire lower 86 percent is a broad perfectly flat buildable plain, fine dust and small sparse pebbles only. No craters or large rocks anywhere on the buildable area. Only a thin low distant ridge at the horizon. Upper 14 percent black airless sky. Same neutral sunlight from upper left. No atmosphere, clouds, fog, vegetation or text. Surface should work as a generic Earth's Moon layer, no Earth or other planet in sky.

Use case: stylized-concept. Reference controls the camera and flat layout ONLY. EMPTY AIRLESS ICY MOON plain for a human base, Tethys-like water-ice surface. Wide 1792x1024 panorama. EXACTLY flat broad level buildable plain covers bottom 86 percent, fine pale silver-white ice regolith, subtle cool blue-grey shadows and tiny sparse ice fragments, not blue glass or ocean. Horizon at 14 percent from top, thin low ancient icy ridge very far away. Black vacuum sky above. Upper-left sunlight, crisp shadows, no fog or atmosphere, no falling snow, no deep cracks or craters or large rocks on building area. NO buildings, machines, roads, people, text, planet or rings in sky. Refined realistic strategy-game background matching camera of reference base.
